objective.text: Restrict scheduled work to the intended application environments.

difficulty.rationale: Restrict the scheduled operation using the scheduler’s environment condition.

stem: A billing command is registered on all environments, but the scheduler should consider it eligible only in production. Which event constraint expresses that requirement?
